title: Care changes with the circumstances
meaning: The overall tone combines adaptable action and a wish to nurture growth with an emotional recognition that an earlier form has ended.
text: The Wheel of Fortune in the physical position of this Energy Field appears through revised shared actions when circumstances change. The Empress in energy connects effort with caring for something that grows and bears fruit. Death in emotions describes the experience of an ending: even a useful adjustment may involve saying goodbye to an earlier form of a shared activity. Wanting to continue caring does not remove the feeling that a familiar way of spending time together has reached its end.

For example, you have welcomed friends around a large table for years, but now only a smaller room is available. You change to separate gatherings with a few guests at a time, keeping your attention on each person. There is also sadness about losing the larger, noisier circle. **We are still creating warmth, although the old format has ended.** Both of you may enjoy the new gatherings while continuing to miss the evenings you used to have.

A difficulty arises if the growth of something new becomes a demand to stop feeling sad immediately. Care then begins to argue against the experience of losing a familiar form. The reverse is also possible: the ending is treated as evidence that continuing the shared activity is pointless. Death here concerns the emotional experience of transition; it does not predict the end of the relationship or rule out further closeness.
